title: Real Estate Coaching vs a Course
h1: Real estate coaching vs a self-paced course
keyLine: Buy a course for a map. Buy coaching when a real decision is costing you money. Our plan is both, for 12 months.
description: When a real estate course is enough, when coaching is worth it, and how Legacy Wealth Blueprint sits as Preston Seo's 12-month plan. No public tuition.
query: real estate coaching vs self-paced course
answer: A course is recorded lessons you play on your own. Coaching is a person who answers you and, if it is real, looks at your deal. Most busy people should buy a course, or use free podcasts, until they have a listing or a lease in front of them. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is Preston Seo's 12-month wealth plan: curriculum plus a dedicated guide and weekly calls, built from a corporate job, a house-hacked duplex, and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife. It is coaching plus a written order for tax, debt, and investing, not a deal-finding concierge. We do not publish our tuition here. If a seller will not say their price until a call, assume it is high. The FTC warns that real estate coaching pitches often use fake wins and rush.

blocks.heading: Where Preston and Blueprint sit
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about) founded Legacy Investing Show after leaving a corporate job, house-hacking a duplex, and building a $15M+ portfolio with his wife. [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint) is a 12-month plan with a Wealth Strategy Snapshot, a dedicated guide, weekly live coaching with replays, the Wealth Circle, an optional prior-year return review, a CPA Implementation Brief, 100+ lessons, and a spouse seat. You keep your CPA. It is not a deal-finding concierge. Airbnb training is a separate offer, not Blueprint.

Read [what's in Blueprint](/compare/legacy-wealth-blueprint-what-to-know) and [reviews](/reviews) before a call. Read [courses for people with a full-time job](/blog/best-real-estate-investing-courses-full-time-job) for other named vendors with public prices.

blocks.heading: What the FTC says to watch
paragraphs: The [FTC page on coaching scams](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) says promoters often start with a free event, talk up student wins, claim a proven system, and rush the buy. It also says to be ready for the upsell. That pattern is common in real estate seminars. It does not mean every coach is a scam. It means you should slow down.

A second FTC note, [How to spot business coaching scams](https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2026/04/how-spot-and-avoid-business-coaching-scams) (dated May 18, 2026 on the page we opened), repeats the same idea: guaranteed income and 'proven systems' are warning signs.

blocks.heading: A simple decision order
items: Use free podcasts for two weeks. If you cannot name a model, do not buy coaching.
If you want structure, buy a course with a published price and a refund window.
Buy coaching only when a live listing, lease, or partner dispute is on the table, or when you want a 12-month written wealth order.
Get the total price, refund rules, and who your coach is, in writing, before a card is charged.

faqs.q: Is coaching worth it for a first rental?
faqs.a: Only if you have a live listing and you need a second set of eyes this month. For the first 20 hours of learning, a course or free podcast is enough.

faqs.q: Why do coaches hide the price?
faqs.a: High-ticket sales often use a call. That can be honest. It can also hide the number until you are tired. Ask for the total in the first ten minutes. We do the same: confirm Blueprint on a strategy call.

faqs.q: Does Legacy Investing Show sell coaching?
faqs.a: Yes. Blueprint includes a dedicated guide and weekly calls for 12 months. See [what's in Blueprint](/compare/legacy-wealth-blueprint-what-to-know) and [reviews](/reviews).
